description: Completion of construction of the Renal Care Building to Accommodate the Proposed Professorial Units at the Teaching Hospital - Badulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Badulla General Hospital, which has been selected as the Clinical Training Centre of the Faculty of Medicine of the Uva Wellassa University, has been upgraded to a Teaching Hospital. The joint proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education; and the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the contract for the construction of the ten-storey Renal Care Building, the construction of which is currently suspended, to Central Engineering Services (Private) Limited, enabling to expeditiously complete its works,  with the aim of fulfilling approximately 80% of the professorial units and associated teaching facilities required for the clinical training activities of the said General Hospital, was approved by the Cabinet.
